narrative.gap_prioritization_md:
The six-factor prioritization formula evaluates each gap across: Gap Size (25%), Peer Comparison (20%), Strategic Alignment to Access CU's 5 strategic objectives (15%), Implementation Complexity inverted (15%), Business Impact (15%), and Stakeholder Readiness (10%). Scores on each factor are normalized 0.0–1.0.
Formula: Priority = (0.25 × Gap_Size) + (0.20 × Peer_Comparison) + (0.15 × Strategic_Alignment) + (0.15 × Implementation_Complexity_inverted) + (0.15 × Business_Impact) + (0.10 × Stakeholder_Readiness)
narrative.recommendations_md: Six recommendations derived from the gap prioritization analysis. Each follows the mandatory protocol: ROOT CAUSE (evidence-cited gaps) → SOLUTION (Zennify offering + implementation approach) → EXPECTED OUTCOMES (table with baseline, target, and business impact). All six recommendations are validated as NOT currently deployed at Access Credit Union — confirmed via Exa semantic search, LeadIQ tech stack analysis, and 120-item evidence sweep.
narrative.roadmap_md:
The four-phase roadmap sequences Salesforce deployments by urgency — not capability maturity. Phase 1 addresses the two non-discretionary triggers active in Q2 2026: the Moosehorn branch closure (June 19) and Bill C-12 (March 26). Phases 2-4 build the platform layer by layer: FSC foundation → data/lending → full AI activation. The roadmap targets level 2.90 overall maturity by 2028, advancing from the current level 1.58 — a step-change from Developing to near-Established across all four pillars.
Benchmark: A New England credit union deployed Salesforce FSC in 3 months, with AI capabilities live by month 5, achieving 22% contact center volume reduction and 31% ROI in year 1 (Vivify, February 2026). Salesforce and Google Cloud announced expanded Agentforce/Gemini Enterprise integration on April 22, 2026 — AWS-hosted Access CU infrastructure compatible at deployment time.
